M1_01_lga_rate_and_hotspots: Method 1 LGA zero-dose rate for 2026 and Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot clusters, 773 modelled LGAs; Guzamala (Borno) not estimated.
M1_02_state_hotspots_2026_2028: Forecast state zero-dose hotspots 2026-2028 (Getis-Ord Gi*, Queen contiguity) from the Method 1 Bayesian state model.
M1_03_pareto: Pareto concentration of modelled 2026 zero-dose burden across 773 LGAs (Method 1), with the number of LGAs needed to reach 50%, 60% and 80%.
M1_04_nmdhs_validation: Method 1 state forecasts for 2026 against the Nigeria mini Demographic and Health Survey 2025-26 (not used in fitting).
M1_05_ihme_concordance: Method 1 LGA estimates (2026) against the IHME Local Burden of Disease DTP1 surface (2018).
M2_01_model_schematic: Structure of the Bayesian small-area model (Method 2).
M2_02_rate_and_uncertainty_maps: Method 2 LGA zero-dose rate for 2026 and the width of its 95% credible interval, all 774 LGAs.
M2_03_burden_and_priority_maps: Method 2 modelled zero-dose children per LGA and the posterior probability of being among the 155 highest-burden LGAs.
M2_04_top20_lgas: Twenty highest-burden LGAs under Method 2 with 95% credible intervals and probability of top-20% membership (P).
M2_05_diagnostics: Method 2 model performance: posterior predictive fit to all NDHS rounds, independent NmDHS 2025-26 check, and MCMC diagnostics.
M2_06_covariate_effects: Posterior covariate effects in the Bayesian small-area model (log-odds of zero-dose per standard deviation).
M2_07_admin_vs_survey: Routine administrative coverage compared with survey-anchored small-area estimates.
C_01_zone_comparison: Modelled zero-dose children by zone, 2026, under Method 1 and Method 2, with 95% intervals.
C_02_state_comparison: Modelled zero-dose children by state, 2026, under both methods.
C_03_agreement_independent_data: Spearman rank correlation of each method with independent data: NmDHS 2025-26 (states) and IHME 2018 (LGAs, overall and within state).
C_04_pareto_both_methods: Cumulative share of modelled zero-dose children by number of LGAs targeted, both methods (Method 2 band = 95% credible interval).
C_05_lga_scatter: LGA-level agreement between Method 1 and Method 2, 773 LGAs.
A_01_archetype_map_burden: LGA structural archetypes (Ward clustering of 15 covariates) and the share of modelled zero-dose children in each, under both methods.
A_02_maternal_care: Antenatal care and facility delivery against modelled zero-dose by archetype.
